name: lesson-plan-compiler
description: Draft, review, and compile standards-compliant university course teaching plans (教案) from course materials and syllabi into Markdown and Word.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and compile university course teaching plans (教案).
interface.longDescription: Convert course materials, a course syllabus (大纲), and optional training-program evidence into a reusable course teaching plan (教案): plan, draft, review, check, and compile an editable Markdown working document and a standards-compliant Word document.
capabilities: Draft course teaching plans (教案) from course materials and syllabi
Review and check teaching-plan structure and placeholders
Compile teaching plans to standards-compliant Word
defaultPrompt: Draft a teaching plan (教案) from these course materials and syllabus.
Compile this teaching plan to a standards-compliant Word document.
